WITH media_type_rates AS (
    SELECT
        mt.MediaTypeId,
        mt.Name AS MediaTypeName,
        AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS Rate
    FROM MediaType AS mt
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
)
SELECT
    MediaTypeName,
    Rate,
    Rate - AVG(Rate) OVER () AS AmountAboveAverage
FROM media_type_rates
WHERE Rate > AVG(Rate) OVER ();

assumptions.assumption: The rate for each media type is the simple average of its tracks’ bytes-per-millisecond rates; the comparison average gives equal weight to each media type with at least one track whose Bytes value is non-NULL. Tracks with NULL Bytes cannot contribute a rate.
